summary: Ship the one-keystroke Raycast command and HUD feedback
description: Prerequisites: T007-capture-service. Add a repository-owned Raycast script command that invokes the installed CLI, keeps focus in Mail, and renders concise non-blocking HUD outcomes.
acceptance: The success path shows Todoist task created without opening Todoist or changing the selected mail.
Existing-task, no-selection, missing-credential, definitive failure, and uncertain-delivery outcomes are concise, distinguishable, and tested without live apps.
